subject: a chibi human knight with a round steel helmet open at the face, a hero-blue tunic over steel armour and steel boots
notes: The sword is held in the front hand and points straight up. The kite shield is held in the back hand, behind the body on the left. Copy the held item's shape and colours from the reference images, drawn small enough for the hand. RIG POSE: a full-body chibi character for a cut-out skeleton rig, about two and a half heads tall. Three-quarter view FACING RIGHT: the face, the eyes and the toes all point to the right side of the image. The front arm (nearer the viewer) is a short stubby tube that sticks out forward and down at about 45 degrees, straight, with a round shoulder and a round mitten hand, with clear background between the arm and the body. The back arm is a short stubby tube that sticks out backward and down to the left of the body, with clear background between it and the body. Legs are two short stubby legs with round boots, slightly apart in a small stride, with background between them. Nothing crosses in front of the body. No cape, no cloak, no long hair or beard over the arms. Held items stay clear of the head and body. Lineless and simple like the rest of the set.
